title: Chapter 347
text:
Through the battlefield maintenance, Han Xiao reverse engineered a few new blueprints, including floating turrets, large-caliber defensive machine guns, and three types of soldier-level armor: assault, reconnaissance, and defense. As he expected, the NCO Class armor required [Heavy Mechanical Modification], and its progress was stuck.

However, Han Technician was not the type to return empty-handed. He used his connections with the military and spent more than 2,000 Enas to buy three different types of NCO Class armor. When he returned to Juberly Hub and learned [Heavy Mechanical Modification], he would be able to produce the blueprints and sell them to the players under him. He could easily earn back the cost of the armor.

"Everyone got 12,000 Enas. Our market spending power has greatly increased." Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. This kind of armor was very easy to sell. He only needed to invest some EXP to upgrade the blueprints. Furthermore, he had the bonus of Machinery Affinity, so the armor he produced was much better than the assembly line. After he sold it, he could even earn long-term repair fees.

The commission he earned from accepting the mission was only about one class advancement knowledge, but through this group of players, his income could multiply many times.

The Black Star Mercenary Group's Credibility Points had increased quite a bit, and they finally had their first battle employment resume. The Sunil Race had written down the details of the mission, and it showed that the mercenary group had applied for the most dangerous wild mission, which they had completed perfectly without any casualties. This new resume could be said to be extremely valuable.

The Sunil Faction Favorability was unlocked, and it increased by 1,000 points, reaching friendly.

Furthermore, the Reputation increased by five points, which was two points more than the original reward. The Black Star Mercenary's reputation started to improve in the mercenary industry. The most direct improvement was that the faction reward limit increased by 10,000 EXP, which increased by twenty-six times. In other words, there were twenty-six more reward points available every day.

After the payment was settled, the mercenaries left one after another, but Han Xiao still stayed in Forest City. The players had stayed for a few days, and some could not sit still anymore.

On this day, they went to find Han Xiao. Mad Blade was confused. "Black Phantom, you …"

"Call me Black Star." Han Xiao knocked on Mad Blade's head.

Mad Blade was helpless. "Black Star, when are we going back? Is there anything else you want to do here?"

"Waiting for someone."

The players thought that after the Catastrophe was over, the mission would come to an end. However, in Han Xiao's eyes, it was just the beginning!

…

One day later, the Sunil military sent someone to inform Han Xiao that Herlous wished to meet with him. Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and smiled.

"He's finally here."

He followed the soldier to a base facility and walked into a private room. Herlous stood up from the chair, waved his hand, and asked the soldier to leave. After closing the door, only the two of them were left in the room.

There were two glasses of wine on the table. Han Xiao glanced at them and sat down directly. He chuckled and said, "I thought you would look for me earlier."

"I was delayed by some matters. I had to cooperate with the military's publicity. I also lent the armor left behind by my brother to the research institute." Herlous had a helpless look on his face. He did not expect to receive such grand treatment. There were three main reasons. First, it was to dilute the effects of the split. Second, Herlous himself was very strong. Strength represented status. There were only two Grade B Supers in the entire race. After Fernas left, there was another Herlous. Third, the Admiral Class armor had reappeared.

"You seem to have a lot of things to ask me, but let me ask you a question first …" Han Xiao picked up the wine glass, swirled it slowly, and deliberately said in a slow tone, "Do you believe that I'm a prophet?"

"Half of it." Herlous' eyes were bright. "Did you already foresee that I would protect the future of the race? Is that why you came to contact me?"

"Of course, I didn't know that a bar owner was actually a hidden Grade B Super. I also didn't know that he would wear the Admiral Class armor called Shattering Light to face the Catastrophe." Han Xiao's tone was mocking.

Herlous smiled bitterly. No one knew that his armor was called Shattering Light, so his identity as a prophet was confirmed. However, he still had a question. "How many events can you foresee, and how far into the future can you see?"

"Haha, to be honest, I can only foresee some fragments of the future. I don't know much. If I didn't coincidentally see Sunil's future, I wouldn't have come."

Han Xiao's face was sincere, and he did not even blink.

"I see. Although I don't know much about the galaxy, I heard that foresight is usually limited." Herlous was very glad that Han Xiao had foreseen the future of Sunil and not something else. He could not help but sigh. Maybe this was the long-awaited luck of the race.

Suddenly, Herlous' eyes became sharp. He stared at Han Xiao and said with a deep voice, "Then, what is your goal?"

The atmosphere suddenly became heavy, and Herlous' aura was faintly visible. He thought that Han Xiao definitely had something in mind. Otherwise, he would not have revealed his identity as a prophet for no reason. He definitely wanted to get something from Sunil.

Han Xiao pondered, put down the wine glass, and slowly said, "Let me tell you a story …"

"On a backward planet with a surface civilization, there was a handsome man who was used as a test subject. One day, he was arranged to do an experiment, and he awakened the ability to foresee. He saw many fragments of the future, and with his foresight, he successfully escaped and obtained freedom. He then killed the evil enemies on that planet and became a legend that could be seen all over the planet. However, at this time, he saw a new future. A man-made disaster would descend on his mother planet soon, and the mastermind behind it was hidden deep in the galaxy. Therefore, he left the planet and stepped into a bigger world to find a way to save his mother planet … "

Han Xiao adjusted his collar. "I'm just a nobody. It's that handsome man."

Herlous could not keep a straight face, and his mouth twitched. He did not know if this was normal in the galaxy, but in the eyes of the Sunils, it was shameless …

"You and I are of different races, so it's normal for us to have different tastes," Han Xiao said generously.

"Oh …" Herlous believed him. He was stunned for a while before suddenly remembering the important matter. "You're saying that you entered the universe to save your mother planet? Does this have anything to do with Sunil?"

Han Xiao smiled. "My mother planet is in the Garton Star System, and it's about to face a disaster. I'm sure the Sunils are very familiar with the name of the mastermind behind it."

Herlous blinked, and his expression suddenly changed. "Dark-star?"

He suddenly felt enlightened. Everything was connected!

Dark-star is our common enemy, so he came to Sunil. This is the motive!

This time, Han Xiao added, "The mercenaries under me are all warriors from the same planet. They're very clear about this and are only following me to find a way to save their planet. They can testify for me at any time. I'm helping you because we're in the same boat and also to find allies. You already know why I'm here, so you can rest assured. "

Herlous' expression softened, and he was filled with respect. "So, you're the same as the Sunil Guardians, a hero who wants to protect his own planet."

Han Xiao did not blush and said humbly, "You're flattering me. I'm not a hero."

Suddenly, Han Technician felt like he had returned to the time when he had just transmigrated and pretended to be brainwashed. His Oscar soul was burning.

At this moment, Herlous felt that Han Xiao's figure had suddenly become taller, and he felt a little ashamed.
